mechanism: Both agents are CNS depressants; chlorpromazine may increase morphine levels via CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inhibition, and chlorpromazine has anticholinergic effects that delay gastric motility and morphine absorption.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and constipation; consider dose reduction of morphine; counsel patients to avoid alcohol and use caution with concurrent CNS depressants.
